title: The transform generation this contract's evidence belongs to
why: A fixture or a store record is evidence about the transform that produced it, and only about that one. The frozen collection was once found to hold 67 materials whose tangent numbers predated a correction and were evidence of nothing -- they looked exactly like current ones. So the current fingerprint is recorded in ONE place that both repositories read, rather than as a constant hard-coded on each side where the two can drift silently.
evidence_status: This fingerprint identifies current code as of 2026-10-02 (corpus robustness campaign B6: the combined material-point driver's Makefile honours a caller's FC and gains a clean target, and the transform summary again names the author's source rather than the staged bundle copy). The current corpus evidence -- pass20 (67 entries verified in Abaqus 2021.HF5 and 109 at the routine level, of 238 eligible) and the 113 frozen cases -- was produced at ab32cce7bec15c93 (commit 4123acc). An A/B of ab32cce7bec15c93 against a4f0ea8c9d124f18 (corpus_campaign/batches/B6/vera_b6/REPORT.md: 16 corpus sources incl. 6 multi-file bundles, 6 parameter-sensitivity contracts, 7 sampled frozen cases at 49/49 recorded transform sha256) found every generated Fortran file, compile_hint.sh, dependency and output CSV byte-identical; only reporting and build files differ (derivative_manifest.json's generated_at and source path, and the driver Makefile and its objects). Nothing compiled or judged changed, so that evidence stands for this fingerprint. Corpus pass16 (dbe9f928191e1d43) is history. The two Residual Assembler fixtures in tests/fixtures/verified were produced at dbe9f928191e1d43 and are history until re-frozen at this fingerprint. The verified collection under umat/ (pass12, 94a92c01814f107a), the ten fixtures under Residual Assembler tests/fixtures/historical and every earlier generation stay retired from current capability claims and regression baselines: preserve their original generation and numerical observations and read them only as history. The re-freeze procedure is documented in docs/evidence/final_refreeze.md in both repositories.
covers: every file under src/umat_oti whose suffix is .py, .f90, .f, .for or .inc, except the subpackages listed in umat_oti.store.transform_store.NOT_TRANSFORM_CODE, which cannot change a stored transform
how_to_update: Run umat_oti.store.transform_fingerprint(), put the result here, regenerate contract_lock.json, and copy both into Residual_Assembler/schemas/. Everything frozen at the previous value is now evidence about a transform that no longer exists: re-freeze it or read it only as history. This is NOT a contract version bump -- the shape of the agreement is unchanged; what changed is which evidence is current.
consumers_must: refuse a fixture whose transform_fingerprint differs from this value as a regression baseline, and treat a fixture carrying no fingerprint as NOT ESTABLISHED rather than as current
